scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Hey, folks! Here's something you don't see everyday!
Something you can never find in Rune-Midgarts!
Something that makes you happy with just one bite!
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
嘿，各位！这可是难得一见的东西！
在卢恩·米德加兹绝对找不到的珍品！
只要尝上一口就能让你开心不已！

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
It's the perfect dessert and the perfect gift for loved ones.
High-quality, traditional homemade chocolate only 5000z each!
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
这是完美的甜点，也是送给挚爱的最佳礼物。
高品质传统手工巧克力，每块只需5000泽尼！

scripts.text: I'll take it, please!
scripts.translation: 我要买！

scripts.text: I want to wrap the chocolate!
scripts.translation: 我想包装巧克力！

scripts.text: End trading.
scripts.translation: 结束交易。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Ahaha, my dear.
This chocolate is nothing like others.
Every piece bears the devotion of the person who made it!
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
啊哈哈，亲爱的。
这巧克力可与众不同。
每一块都蕴含着制作者的深情厚意！

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
So, that's why I can't sell more than 5 of them at a time.
If you really really want more, then talk to me again.
How many do you want anyway?
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
所以，我一次最多只能卖给你5块。
如果你真的非常想要更多，那就再跟我说说。
你到底想要多少呢？

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Oh, it's such a shame!
I'm sure you'll miss this opportunity and regret you didn't buy it.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
哦，真可惜！
我相信你会错过这个机会，后悔没买下它。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Remember, you can never find this anywhere else!
Come back anytime, when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
记住，你在别处绝对找不到这种巧克力！
随时欢迎你改变主意后回来。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Ugh.. Didn't I tell you?
5 is the maximum!
I can't sell more than that to the same person.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
呃……我没告诉过你吗？
最多5块！
我不能卖给同一个人超过这个数量。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
And you know it's not like an everyday meal.
Eating too much is not really good for you.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
而且你知道这可不是日常便饭。
吃太多对你身体不好。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
You're carrying too many items.
Please use the Kafra Services.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
你携带的物品太多了。
请使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Looks like you don't have enough zeny with ya.
Maybe you should borrow some zeny from a friend.
Cuz, I'm not gonna be here everyday.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
看来你身上的泽尼不够。
也许你应该向朋友借点泽尼。
毕竟，我不会每天都在这儿。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Good for you!
It's also perfect as a gift!
You know you can't get this kind of chocolate normally.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
太好了！
这也非常适合作为礼物！
你知道这种巧克力在平常是买不到的。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
If you want more, you should come back.
Might be a good idea to buy some more while you have a chance...!
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
如果你想要更多，就再来吧。
趁现在有机会多买点是个好主意……！

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
If you want to gift-wrap the chocolate, of course, you need chocolate, plus, wrapping paper, wrapping strap and a box.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
如果你想给巧克力做礼品包装，当然，你需要巧克力，加上包装纸、包装带和一个盒子。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
You also need to pay 500 zeny to carve your name on the box.
Are you all prepared...?
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
你还需要支付500泽尼，以便在盒子上刻上你的名字。
你都准备好了吗……？

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Hmm.. Looks like you don't have enough materials to decorate the gift box..
You can't just put your gift into some plain looking box..
Don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
嗯……看来你没有足够的材料来装饰礼盒。
你不能只是把礼物放进一个普普通通的盒子里吧……
你不这么认为吗？

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
You need to bring some wrapping paper, wrapping strap, and a box.
Oh, also bring 500 zeny, and don't forget to bring your true loving heart with you!!
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
你需要带些包装纸、包装带和一个盒子。
哦，还要带上500泽尼，别忘了带上你真挚的爱心！！

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Hey, look, adventurer!
I can't create something right away!
You know I'm not an alchemist or anything.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
嘿，看这里，冒险者！
我不能立刻变出东西来！
你知道我又不是炼金术士什么的。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
You're not saying that you want an empty chocolate box without any chocolate in it, am I right?
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
你不是说你想要一个里面没有巧克力的空盒子吧，我没说错吧？

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
You're carrying too many items.
Please use the Kafra Services.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
你携带的物品太多了。
请使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Here, look!
It's your chocolate box with your name on it.
Isn't it fabulous?
See, your name looks great on the box!
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
来，看！
这是刻有你名字的巧克力盒。
是不是很华丽？
看，你的名字在盒子上看起来棒极了！

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Happy Valentine's Day!
Valentine's the reason I came back.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
情人节快乐！
情人节就是我回来的原因。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Oh, it's such a shame!
I'm sure you'll miss this opportunity and regret you didn't buy it.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
哦，真可惜！
我相信你会错过这个机会，后悔没买下它。

scripts.text:
[Marco Bassinio]
Remember, you can never find this anywhere else!
Come back anytime, when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[马可·巴西尼奥]
记住，你在别处绝对找不到这种巧克力！
随时欢迎你改变主意后回来。

scripts.text:
[Packs Trader]
Hello.
I am a Packs Trader, I sell paper boxes and supplies for packing presents.
scripts.translation:
[背包商人]
你好。
我是背包商人，我出售用于包装礼物的纸盒和用品。

scripts.text:
[Packs Trader]
Do you have something to buy?
scripts.translation:
[背包商人]
你有什么要买的吗？

scripts.text: Packing Paper
scripts.translation: 包装纸

scripts.text: Packing Ribbon
scripts.translation: 包装带

scripts.text: Box
scripts.translation: 盒子

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Packs Trader]
It's 200 zeny for 1 Packing Paper.
How many do you want?
You can't buy more than 10 items at once.
scripts.translation:
[背包商人]
一张包装纸200泽尼。
你想要多少？
一次不能购买超过10个物品。

scripts.text:
[Packs Trader]
Nothing to buy.
Come back when you need something.
scripts.translation:
[背包商人]
没什么可买的。
需要的时候再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Packs Trader]
I told you not to buy more than 10...
scripts.translation:
[背包商人]
我告诉过你不要买超过10个……

scripts.text:
[Packs Trader]
You're carrying too many items.
Please use the Kafra Services.
scripts.translation:
[背包商人]
你携带的物品太多了。
请使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Packs Trader]
You don't have enough money.
Please check your wallet.
scripts.translation:
[背包商人]
你的钱不够。
请检查一下你的钱包。

scripts.text:
[Packs Trader]
Here they are.
Hope it makes your Valentine's Day more pleasing!
scripts.translation:
[背包商人]
给你。
希望这能让你的情人节更加愉快！

scripts.text:
[Packs Trader]
It's 200 zeny for 1 Packing Ribbon.
How many do you want?
You can't buy more than 10 items at once.
scripts.translation:

一条包装带200泽尼。
你想要多少？
一次不能购买超过10个物品。

scripts.text:

Nothing to buy.
Come back when you need something.

It's 600 zeny for 1 Box.
How many do you want?
You can't buy more than 10 items at once.
scripts.translation:

一个盒子600泽尼。
你想要多少？
一次不能购买超过10个物品。

scripts.text:

Nothing to buy.
Come back when you need something.

scripts.text:

Here they are.
Hope it makes your Valentine's Day more pleasing!
scripts.translation:
[背包商人]
给你。
希望这能让你的情人节更加愉快！

scripts.text:
[Packs Trader]
Goodbye!
And enjoy your Valentine's Day.
scripts.translation:
[背包商人]
再见！
祝你情人节过得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
Hello, I only make the Valentine rings to those experienced adventurer Level 75 or above.
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
你好，我只为等级75或以上的资深冒险者制作情人节戒指。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
You're not fully experienced yet.
Come back when you're experienced enough to handle the quests.
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
你还不够资深。
等你有足够的经验处理任务时再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
The box with the ring, carved with your name, is for the one you love.
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
刻有你名字的戒指盒，是送给你心爱之人的。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
As for the rings that you receive from others, they should all be registered with the Vote Manager.
She is standing near the Prontera Fountain.
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
至于你从别人那里收到的戒指，都需要在投票管理员那里登记。
她就站在普隆德拉喷泉附近。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
Only the most popular male and female are subjected to getting rewards.
Be aware, and always try to stay popular!
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
只有最受欢迎的男性和女性才能获得奖励。
请注意，并始终保持人气！

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
Hi, there, how are ya?
Come to me if you're interested in the event, 'Who's Valentine's Hottest?'
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
嗨，你好吗？
如果你对“谁是情人节最热门人物？”活动感兴趣，就来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
I make the most precious rings that you can give to your sweethearts.
Those rings are very special because I carve your names on them!
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
我制作你可以送给心上人的最珍贵的戒指。
这些戒指非常特别，因为我会把你的名字刻在上面！

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
Isn't it exciting?
Isn't it such a brilliant idea?
Give these special rings to your sweethearts!
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
是不是很令人兴奋？
这是个绝妙的主意，不是吗？
把这些特别的戒指送给你的心上人吧！

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
You should hurry 'cuz this event will only last for two weeks.
Give that special someone a gift of a Valentine's ring.
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
你得抓紧时间，因为这个活动只持续两周。
送给那个特别的人一枚情人节戒指作为礼物吧。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
Remember, you can only generate the ring once.
You also need Wrapping Paper, Wrapping Strap and a Box to make the ring.
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
记住，你只能生成一次戒指。
你还需要包装纸、包装带和一个盒子来制作戒指。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
So you better be sure of who you give this to.
By the way, It costs 1,000 zeny.
Would you like to make one?
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
所以你最好确定要把这个送给谁。
顺便说一下，费用是1,000泽尼。
你想做一个吗？

scripts.text: Hmm.. I gotta give it a second thought...
scripts.translation: 嗯……我得再考虑一下……

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
Alrighty!
You can't put a rush on such a thing like this.
Think about what you truly want.
Just follow your heart!
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
好吧！
这种事急不得。
想想你真正想要的是什么。
跟随你的心！

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
Well, you don't have enough materials to make a gift box.
Check what you have, and come back later with all the materials.
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
嗯，你没有足够的材料来制作礼盒。
检查一下你拥有的物品，带上所有材料后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
Okie Dokie!
I'll make it right away.
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
好的！
我马上就开始制作。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
Here, the most precious ring in the world!
Don't forget, you can never make this ring again.
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
给，这是世界上最珍贵的戒指！
别忘了，你再也无法制作这枚戒指了。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
You must pick out the one that you really really love, and give this ring to that person.
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
你必须选出你真心深爱的人，并把这枚戒指送给那个人。

scripts.text:
[Event Ring Maker]
Of course, you've got to get rings from others, that's the way you can participate in the voting, right?
Challenge yourself to become Valentine's Hottest!
scripts.translation:
[活动戒指制作师]
当然，你也得从别人那里获得戒指，这样你才能参与投票，对吧？
挑战自己，成为情人节最热门人物！

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
Hello, I'm the Valentine's Vote Manager.
I'm in charge of collecting rings for this event!
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
你好，我是情人节投票管理员。
我负责收集本次活动的戒指！

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
I register the rings you get from others and I calculate the total number of rings.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
我登记你从别人那里获得的戒指，并计算戒指总数。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
You know what I do besides just counting those rings?
I can tell you the adventurer's name who's got the most number of votes.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
你知道除了统计戒指数量外我还做什么吗？
我可以告诉你得票最多的冒险者的名字。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
Plus, you can also find out how many votes he/she got.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
此外，你还可以知道他/她获得了多少票。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
So, what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
那么，你想要什么？

scripts.text: Please register my rings.
scripts.translation: 请登记我的戒指。

scripts.text: Please count my votes.
scripts.translation: 请统计我的票数。

scripts.text: Nothing, for now.
scripts.translation: 暂时不需要。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
Please tell me how many rings you want to register.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
请告诉我你要登记多少枚戒指。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
When you write the number of the rings, the number shouldn't be larger than the number of rings you actually have.
'0', cancels everything.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
当你输入戒指数量时，数字不应大于你实际拥有的戒指数量。
输入'0'将取消所有操作。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
You have entered 0.
Registration is cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
你输入了0。
登记已取消。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
Seems like the value you entered is too small.
I know you've got more. Be honest, dear.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
看来你输入的数值太小了。
我知道你还有更多。诚实点，亲爱的。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
Seems like the value you entered is too large.
I know you've got less. Be honest, dear.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
看来你输入的数值太大了。
我知道你没那么多。诚实点，亲爱的。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
I'll take those silver rings, and count the votes for you.
Thank you for participating.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
我会收下那些银戒指，并为你统计票数。
感谢你的参与。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
Seems like the value you entered is too small.
I know you've got more. Be honest, dear.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
看来你输入的数值太小了。
我知道你还有更多。诚实点，亲爱的。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
Seems like the value you entered is too large.
I know you've got less. Be honest, dear.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
看来你输入的数值太大了。
我知道你没那么多。诚实点，亲爱的。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
I'll take those gold rings, and count the votes for you.
Thank you for participating.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
我会收下那些金戒指，并为你统计票数。
感谢你的参与。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
Let's see...
You have registered....{0} rings so far.
and...
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
让我看看……
你目前为止已登记……{0}枚戒指。
以及……

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
The current record shows... {0} is the male vote leader who's registered the total of {1} rings.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
目前的记录显示……{0}是男性投票首领，共登记了{1}枚戒指。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
The current record shows... {0} is the female vote leader who's registered the total of {1} rings.
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
目前的记录显示……{0}是女性投票首领，共登记了{1}枚戒指。

scripts.text:
[Valentine Vote Manager]
Hey, you can be popular too!
Anyone can... really!
Though you have to try a lot harder, but still~ Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[情人节投票管理员]
嘿，你也可以很受欢迎！
任何人都可以……真的！
虽然你得更加努力，不过嘛~ 哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Monsieur~! What brings you to my beautiful atelier?
What is it that you want?
Well, my sparkling eyes get dried and lose their shine if not for the pretty little lady.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
先生~！是什么风把你吹到我美丽的工作室来的？
你想要什么？
唉，如果没有漂亮的小姐，我这双闪亮的眼睛就会干涩失神。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Please leave me alone unless you have business with me.
Haaaa~ I'm a busy person.
Don't bother me....
Annoying, annoying, annoying~~!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
除非你有正事，否则请别打扰我。
哈啊~ 我是个忙人。
别烦我……
烦死了，烦死了，烦死了~~！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, Mademoiselle!
This little trifling space felt like heaven the minute you walked in!
Can I help you with anything, if it's alright?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哦，小姐！
你走进来的那一刻，这狭小的空间仿佛变成了天堂！
如果不介意的话，我能为你做些什么吗？

scripts.text: Please, make me some chocolate.
scripts.translation: 请给我做些巧克力。

scripts.text: Don't bother. I'm just passing by.
scripts.translation: 别麻烦了。我只是路过。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ahhh, this is so heartbreaking.
How could you say that?
You're just so mean.
Don't bother? Just passing by?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊啊，太让人心碎了。
你怎么能这么说？
你真残忍。
别麻烦？只是路过？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
What can I do to make you
pay a little attention to me?
Please.. I feel like my soul is lost..
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
我该怎么做才能让你
稍微关注我一点呢？
求你了……我觉得我的灵魂迷失了……

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ahhh, Mademoiselle.
I'm not an alchemist, or a magician.
I don't just make chocolate out of anything.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊啊，小姐。
我不是炼金术士，也不是魔法师。
我不会随便用什么东西就做巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I always think of making chocolate as artistic work.
You see, I'm no ordinary cook...
I make chocolate with feelings..
messages of loving hearts..
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
我总是把制作巧克力视为艺术创作。
你看，我不是普通的厨师……
我是用感情制作巧克力……
传递爱心的讯息……

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I make masterpieces.
No one can imitate the looks and the taste.
Yes, it's nothing like ordinary chocolate!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
我制作的是杰作。
无人能模仿其外观和味道。
是的，这绝非普通的巧克力！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I'm afraid I can't make it and prove it to you now.
This is really a shame!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
恐怕我现在无法为你制作并证明这一点。
真是遗憾！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I really want to thank you for visiting me and if you only bring ^3152ff3 Chocolates^000000, I'll make you chocolate like you've never seen...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
我真的很感谢你来看我，如果你能带来^3152ff3块巧克力^000000，我就为你制作你从未见过的巧克力……

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
never tasted before...
Mademoiselle, with your spirit, I'm sure you can bring 3 pieces of chocolate.
I have no doubt at all.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
从未尝过的味道……
小姐，以你的气质，我相信你能带来3块巧克力。
我对此毫不怀疑。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
So... what do you think?
Can you bring ^3152ff3 Chocolates^000000?
I could get them myself, but I'm tied up with so much work as you see right now.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
那么……你觉得呢？
你能带来^3152ff3块巧克力^000000吗？
我自己可以去弄，但如你所见，我现在工作缠身。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Adios, Mademoiselle.....
I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
再见，小姐……
我会等着你的。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You're carrying too many items.
Please use the Kafra Services.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
你携带的物品太多了。
请使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, Mademoiselle!
I'll make the best chocolate with the pieces you've brought.
I'm going to put the light of your eyes into this chocolate that no one can resist.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哦，小姐！
我会用你带来的巧克力块制作最好的巧克力。
我要将你眼中的光芒融入这无人能抗拒的巧克力中。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
It'll be stronger than a sweet sweet love potion.....
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
它将比甜蜜的爱情魔药更强烈……

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Un, Deux, Trois, Quatre.....
Just like the ugly duckling that turned to a beautiful swan-
Ordinary chocolate pieces are becoming a piece of art!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
Un, Deux, Trois, Quatre……
就像丑小鸭变成美丽的天鹅——
普通的巧克力块正在变成一件艺术品！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
They're changing!
They're getting warm, softly changing the shape, getting stronger again!
Oh, is it a master piece or
what...!!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
它们在变化！
它们变得温暖，柔和地改变形状，再次凝固！
哦，这究竟是杰作还是
什么……！！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Here you go, Mademoiselle!
Ahahahaha, just look at this!
I can't believe I made this.
Oh, I can't take my eyes off..!!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
给你，小姐！
啊哈哈哈哈，快看这个！
我不敢相信这是我做的。
哦，我简直移不开眼……！！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Alright. Mademoiselle,
I hope this is just what you wanted, for it bears your beautiful heart inside.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
好了。小姐，
希望这正是你想要的，因为它蕴含着你美丽的心灵。
